decisions.rationale: Operator decision, strengthened by measurement: the model contributed 0 of 7 published sentences in both languages, while selection — which uses no LLM — kept 7 of 8 URLs. A hosted API would buy quality in the discarded step.
MiniCheck is genuinely SOTA for this shape (77.4% BA) but is 4.7GB with no licence tag on the 7B, and the open follow-up may delete the step it would judge.
Real, MIT, maintained, Ollama first-class — but its value is a prompt x model matrix we do not have. Revisit when comparing two prompts.

decisions.decision: Playwright is not a CI dependency
decisions.rationale: The build-time search-index gate guards every PR and is mutation-verified; a browser download per run is not worth it for one search box.
Derived from git log. Both conventions exist across ~/projetos (3 ignore, ~9 track), so it is a choice for this repo and revertible.

With it on, the docs-only carve-out could not be exercised at all and every prose change cost a PR with no behaviour to review. The mechanism is WIDER than the rule it restores — it permits any admin push, not just prose — so what actually holds the line for code is the local ~/.git-hooks/pre-commit carve-out (11 assertions, both ends), which --no-verify bypasses and GitHub no longer catches. Revert: gh api -X PUT .../protection/enforce_admins

context_notes: Eight PRs merged here (#13-#20) plus claude-config#69, CI green on each, production driven end to end after #14 and re-smoked after #18.
